prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: STL decomposition shows consistently downward trend across both folds. CWT_catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0), while ONLY_DWT_catboost best captures seasonality (0.8582 correlation). However, ONLY_DWT_rf delivers the lowest overall RMSE (114.04). With unstable rankings (Kendall τ=-0.0058), high model disagreement (RMSE spread=8.2), and concept drift detected, robust combiners like median or trimmed mean are preferred over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
